# Senior Fullstack Engineer — phased TypeScript/tRPC/Prisma workflow

Curated by Skill Harbor — @pixel-process-ug's senior-fullstack skill, listed here with credit to its creator: a gated four-phase workflow for shipping complete end-to-end TypeScript applications — Phase 1 designs the Prisma data layer (schema, relationships, index-strategy decision table, seed data, migrations), Phase 2 builds the type-safe tRPC API with Zod validation and an authorization-pattern decision table (RBAC, resource-level, ABAC, feature flags), Phase 3 builds the UI with Next.js Server Components by default and minimal Client Components (component-type decision table, optimistic updates, loading/error states), and Phase 4 prepares production (auth via NextAuth.js/Clerk/Lucia/Supabase, Docker deployment, Sentry/Vercel-analytics monitoring checklist, CI/CD). Each phase ends with a STOP checklist the agent must satisfy before moving on. It also ships an anti-pattern table (raw SQL in components, localStorage tokens, business logic in routers), a full-stack type-safety pipeline diagram, a recommended project structure, integration points with sibling skills (senior-frontend, senior-backend, security-review, testing-strategy), and Context7 doc-lookup instructions for react, next.js, prisma and tailwindcss. Honest caveats: opinionated toward the Next.js + tRPC + Prisma stack — not a fit if you're on a different stack; the Context7 integration points assume an MCP tool of that name is configured. MIT licensed. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself...
